---
description: All user-facing features must work well on mobile devices.
applyTo: '**/*'
---

# Mobile-friendly requirement

Treat mobile support as a baseline requirement for every user-facing feature and every UI change.

- Design responsive layouts that fit narrow viewports without horizontal overflow or clipped controls.
- Make interactive elements usable with touch, keyboard, and assistive technology; do not rely on hover or precise pointer input alone.
- Keep dialogs and scrollable content within the viewport, with touch-friendly controls and usable dismissal/navigation.
- Preserve the feature's behavior across mobile and desktop rather than hiding important functionality on small screens.
- When changing UI, validate the layout and interactions at a narrow mobile viewport as well as desktop when practical.
